relationships.subject: baricitinib
relationships.evidence_quote: At cytokine level, BARI induced, both in the early and the late phase experiments an increase of IFNγ and a decrease of IL-1β

key_findings: Baricitinib and etanercept both improved pain in late-phase CIA mice; effect on joint inflammation comparable.
Baricitinib increased P2X7R on CD4+ T cells when given early and decreased it when given late; etanercept had no effect.
